summary: Preserve bounded, source-cited Japan Guide planning commands with facility identity, dated qualifiers, explicit opening uncertainty and original offline freshness.
reason: Japan Guide publishes structured editorial HTML, with multiple facility schedules, source interest icons and notices outside the main article. A raw link endpoint cannot retain those domain facts or distinguish source schedules from live operating status; source selectors must be rediscovered when the site changes.
validated_outcome: Deterministic domain and CLI protocol tests pass, including charset, facility scope, event identity, original cache freshness, typed throttling, partial failures and fatal snapshot-save errors after successful live acquisition. Actual MCP catalog classifies snapshot-saving inspection as may-write and the other six guide tools as read-only. Real-source acceptance is recorded in .manuscripts/20261002-001811-227018a4/proofs/source-live-acceptance.json.
